name: The Amazing World of Coconut Ura
source:
A mundane senior year ends for Koko when she meets Usa Ura, a small bunny who offers her a magical girl pendant. She accepts, stepping into a life of adventure.

[From [url=https://coconut-ura.itch.io/the-amazing-world-of-coconut-ura]Itch.io[/url]]
